profile_text.body:
ClickUp is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Diego, CA. The company describes itself as building "the everything app for work," combining tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, with a stated mission of making the world more productive.

ClickUp's AI product is called ClickUp AI, categorized as an all-in-one productivity tool covering document generation, task automation, and broad data access across a workspace. The site also highlights a feature called Brain², described as an AI layer that sees tasks, docs, and conversations in real time without requiring additional context from the user.

The held facts note that ClickUp has a registered MCP server, listed under the name ai.smithery/skr-cloudify-clickup-mcp-server-new, which supports managing a ClickUp workspace by creating, updating, and organizing tasks, lists, folders, and tags. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
